characteristic: Many Carried-Over Tasks (71.4% carried over), stalled review pipeline

inputs.goal: Clear carried-over storage bottlenecks and optimize query latency

parsedReport.summary: Sprint 3 focused on addressing storage bottlenecks and optimizing query latencies across key endpoints. While foundational improvements like Redis caching and critical N+1 query resolutions were completed, a significant portion of the work stalled in code review or remained in progress. Streamlining the review phase will be essential to improving throughput in future iterations.
highlights: Successfully added Redis caching for user presence to optimize load handling
Resolved the N+1 query issue on the project task listing endpoint
Progressed complex database and analytics query optimizations into the review pipeline
